target.title: fix(agents): drop orphaned thinking blocks when NO_REPLY text leaves an assistant message with only thinking content (#99620)
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

NO_REPLY yield-turn assistant messages with thinking blocks cause a permanent 400 loop on the next provider request after gateway restart. Dropping the NO_REPLY text without the companion thinking block leaves orphaned thinking blocks that merge with adjacent assistant messages into `[thinking, thinking, tool_use]`, which Anthropic rejects as "cannot be modified."

- **Problem**: When a yield-turn ends with `[thinking(sig), text:"NO_REPLY"]`, `normalizeAssistantReplayBlockContent` drops the silent text but preserves the thinking block. `stripHistoricalRuntimeContextCustomMessages` then removes the intervening `sessions_yield` custom message. Two assistant messages become adjacent, and the provider merges their content — producing `[thinking, thinking, tool_use]` → provider 400 on every retry.
- **Solution**: In `normalizeAssistantReplayBlockContent`, when a silent-reply text block was dropped and the remaining content is only thinking blocks (no `tool_use`, no visible text), drop the entire message. Orphaned thinking blocks from a yield-turn have no replay value — the thinking was produced in a different provider context and cannot be replayed.
- **What changed**: `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/replay-history.ts` (new `hasSilentText` tracking + post-loop orphaned-thinking guard), plus 3 regression tests.
- **What did NOT change**: Normal replay paths, thinking blocks with companion tool_use/text blocks, `stripHistoricalRuntimeContextCustomMessages`, `convertMessages`, any provider-specific code.

## Change Type

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Refactor required for the fix
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Security hardening
- [ ] Chore/infra

## Scope

- [x] Gateway / orchestration
- [x] Skills / tool execution
- [ ] Auth / tokens
- [ ] Memory / storage
- [ ] Integrations
- [ ] API / contracts
- [ ] UI / DX
- [ ] CI/CD / infra

## Linked Issue/PR

- Related to #99620
- [x] This PR fixes a bug or regression

## Motivation

The NO_REPLY yield-turn thinking merge is a deterministic session-killer: once triggered, every subsequent user message rebuilds the same malformed shape and gets a 400 response. The session is permanently bricked until a manual `/new`. The reporter's fleet observed 5 production sessions bricked in a single day (2026-07-03). The existing `stripInvalidThinkingSignatures` and compaction-only strippers do not guard against this path because the signatures are cryptographically valid — they are simply stale from a prior provider context. This is a structural gap in the replay-history normalization pipeline, not a signature-stripping gap.

## Evidence

- **Behavior addressed**: NO_REPLY yield-turn thinking blocks are dropped alongside their companion silent text, preventing adjacent assistant message merge in provider payloads
- **Real environment tested**: Linux, Node 22.19, `fix/no-reply-merge-thinking-99620` branch
- **Exact steps or command run after this patch**:

**Proof 1: Full LLM boundary path (normalizeMessagesForLlmBoundary — combines normalizeAssistantReplayContent + stripHistoricalRuntimeContextCustomMessages)**

```
node --import tsx --input-type=module <<'NODE'
import { normalizeMessagesForLlmBoundary } from './src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt.llm-boundary.ts';

// Full #99620 scenario: user → assistant[yield:thinking+NO_REPLY] → custom(sessions_yield) → assistant[tool-use:thinking+toolCall] → user[result] → assistant[done]
const before = [
  { role: "user", content: "hi", timestamp: 1719000000000 },
  { role: "assistant", content: [{ type:"thinking", thinking:"...", signature:"sig_yield_abc123" }, { type:"text", text:"NO_REPLY" }],
    stopReason:"stop", timestamp:1719000001000, usage:{input:10,output:5,totalTokens:15,cacheRead:0,cacheWrite:0,cost:{input:0,output:0,cacheRead:0,cacheWrite:0,total:0}},
    api:"anthropic-messages", provider:"anthropic", model:"claude-sonnet-4-6" },
  { role: "custom", customType: "openclaw.runtime-context", timestamp: 1719000002000, content: [{ type:"text", text:"continue" }] },
  { role: "assistant", content: [{ type:"thinking", thinking:"...", signature:"sig_next_def456" }, { type:"toolCall", id:"c1", name:"exec", arguments:{} }],
    stopReason:"toolUse", timestamp:1719000003000, usage:{input:15,output:10,totalTokens:25,cacheRead:0,cacheWrite:0,cost:{input:0,output:0,cacheRead:0,cacheWrite:0,total:0}},
    api:"anthropic-messages", provider:"anthropic", model:"claude-sonnet-4-6" },
  { role: "user", content: "[tool result]", timestamp: 1719000004000 },
  { role: "assistant", content: [{ type:"text", text:"Task completed." }], stopReason:"stop", timestamp:1719000005000,
    usage:{input:10,output:3,totalTokens:13,cacheRead:0,cacheWrite:0,cost:{input:0,output:0,cacheRead:0,cacheWrite:0,total:0}},
    api:"anthropic-messages", provider:"anthropic", model:"claude-sonnet-4-6" },
];
const after = normalizeMessagesForLlmBoundary(before);
after.forEach((m,i) => {
  const c = typeof m.content === 'string' ? `"${m.content.slice(0,40)}"` : Array.isArray(m.content) ? `[${m.content.map(b=>b.type).join(', ')}]` : String(m.content);
  console.log(`[${i}] ${m.role} ${c}`);
});
const yieldGone = !after.some(m => Array.isArray(m.content) && m.content.some(b => b.signature === "sig_yield_abc123"));
const toolPreserved = after.some(m => Array.isArray(m.content) && m.content.some(b => b.signature === "sig_next_def456"));
const adj = after.some((m,i) => i>0 && m.role==='assistant' && after[i-1].role==='assistant');
console.log(`Yield thinking dropped: ${yieldGone} | Tool thinking preserved: ${toolPreserved} | Adjacent assistants: ${adj}`);
NODE
```

**Proof 2: normalizeAssistantReplayContent unit-level (3 regression scenarios)**

```
node --import tsx --input-type=module <<'NODE'
import { normalizeAssistantReplayContent } from './src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/replay-history.ts';

const msgs1 = [ {role:"user",content:"hi",timestamp:0}, {role:"assistant",content:[ {type:"thinking",thinking:"analyze",signature:"sig_abc"}, {type:"text",text:"NO_REPLY"} ],stopReason:"stop",timestamp:0,usage:{input:10,output:5,totalTokens:15,cacheRead:0,cacheWrite:0,cost:{input:0,output:0,cacheRead:0,cacheWrite:0,total:0}},api:"anthropic-messages",provider:"anthropic",model:"claude-sonnet-4-6"} ];
const out1 = normalizeAssistantReplayContent(msgs1);
const msgs2 = [ {role:"user",content:"hi",timestamp:0}, {role:"assistant",content:[{type:"thinking",thinking:"yield",signature:"sig_y"},{type:"text",text:"NO_REPLY"}],stopReason:"stop",timestamp:0,usage:{input:10,output:5,totalTokens:15,cacheRead:0,cacheWrite:0,cost:{input:0,output:0,cacheRead:0,cacheWrite:0,total:0}},api:"anthropic-messages",provider:"anthropic",model:"claude-sonnet-4-6"}, {role:"assistant",content:[{type:"thinking",thinking:"next",signature:"sig_n"},{type:"toolCall",id:"c1",name:"exec",arguments:{}}],stopReason:"toolUse",timestamp:0,usage:{input:10,output:10,totalTokens:20,cacheRead:0,cacheWrite:0,cost:{input:0,output:0,cacheRead:0,cacheWrite:0,total:0}},api:"anthropic-messages",provider:"anthropic",model:"claude-sonnet-4-6"}, {role:"user",content:"[result]",timestamp:0}, {role:"assistant",content:[{type:"text",text:"done"}],stopReason:"stop",timestamp:0,usage:{input:10,output:3,totalTokens:13,cacheRead:0,cacheWrite:0,cost:{input:0,output:0,cacheRead:0,cacheWrite:0,total:0}},api:"anthropic-messages",provider:"anthropic",model:"claude-sonnet-4-6"} ];
const out2 = normalizeAssistantReplayContent(msgs2);
const msgs3 = [ {role:"user",content:"hi",timestamp:0}, {role:"assistant",content:[{type:"thinking",thinking:"real",signature:"sig_t"},{type:"toolCall",id:"c1",name:"exec",arguments:{}},{type:"text",text:"NO_REPLY"}],stopReason:"stop",timestamp:0,usage:{input:10,output:8,totalTokens:18,cacheRead:0,cacheWrite:0,cost:{input:0,output:0,cacheRead:0,cacheWrite:0,total:0}},api:"anthropic-messages",provider:"anthropic",model:"claude-sonnet-4-6"} ];
const out3 = normalizeAssistantReplayContent(msgs3);
const types3 = out3[1].content.map(b=>b.type);
console.log("T1:", out1.length===1 ? "PASS" : "FAIL", "| T2 roles:", out2.map(m=>m.role).join("→"), out2.length===4 ? "PASS" : "FAIL", "| T3:", JSON.stringify(types3), types3.includes("thinking")&&types3.includes("toolCall") ? "PASS" : "FAIL");
NODE
```

- **Evidence after fix**:

```console
$ node --import tsx --input-type=module <<'NODE'  (Proof 1 — full LLM boundary)
[0] user "hi"
[1] assistant [thinking, toolCall]
[2] user "[tool result]"
[3] assistant [text]
Yield thinking dropped: true | Tool thinking preserved: true | Adjacent assistants: false
```

```console
$ node --import tsx --input-type=module <<'NODE'  (Proof 2 — unit-level)
T1: PASS | T2 roles: user→assistant→user→assistant PASS | T3: ["thinking","toolCall"] PASS
```

| Scenario | Input | Output | Result |
|----------|-------|--------|--------|
| Full LLM boundary (replay + runtime-context strip) | 6 msgs incl. custom | 4 msgs, roles alternate | No adjacent merge |
| Yield turn `[thinking, NO_REPLY]` | 2 msgs | 1 msg (user only) | Yield dropped |
| Yield → next tool turn | 5 msgs (yield+tool+user+done) | 4 msgs, roles alternate | No adjacent merge |
| Yield with tool_use sibling | 2 msgs (user + [thinking, toolCall, NO_REPLY]) | 2 msgs, thinking+toolCall preserved | Boundary safe |

- **Observed result after fix**:
  1. Full `normalizeMessagesForLlmBoundary` pipeline: yield-turn dropped, runtime-context custom message stripped, tool-use assistant preserved — no adjacent assistant messages
  2. Unit-level: yield-turn thinking blocks correctly dropped when only companion text was NO_REPLY
  3. Boundary safety: thinking blocks preserved when a tool_use block provides replay value
  4. Unit tests: 31 tests pass, no regressions
- **What was not tested**: Live Anthropic API round-trip (requires API key with thinking-enabled access). The fix relies on source-level verification against the reported merge pattern and the proven normalization infrastructure.

**Relationship to PR #99383**: This PR is a narrow companion fix for the NO_REPLY yield-turn merge path specifically. PR #99383 (Sunjae-k) takes the broader approach of dropping all completed-turn thinking blocks. The two are complementary: if #99383 lands first, this PR's guard becomes a safety net for the narrower NO_REPLY path; if this PR lands first, the NO_REPLY yield-turn class is closed while #99383 covers the remaining completion-replay surface.

## Root Cause

The `normalizeAssistantReplayBlockContent` function at `replay-history.ts:226` drops silent-reply text blocks but preserves companion thinking blocks. When `stripHistoricalRuntimeContextCustomMessages` subsequently removes the sessions_yield custom message that separated the yield-turn from the next assistant message, two assistant messages become adjacent in the output array. The provider serialization layer (`convertMessages`) merges adjacent same-role messages, producing `[thinking, thinking, tool_use]` which Anthropic rejects as invalid.

Provenance:
- `normalizeAssistantReplayBlockContent`: carried forward from the Jun 25 runtime refactor (`af906225fa`)
- `stripHistoricalRuntimeContextCustomMessages`: carried forward from the same refactor
- Made visible by: users running NO_REPLY yield patterns with thinking-enabled models
- Confidence: **clear**

## Regression Test Plan

- `replay-history.test.ts` — 3 new tests cover: (1) yield-with-thinking dropped, (2) full adjacency scenario, (3) tool_use boundary preserved
- `thinking.test.ts` — 53 tests pass unchanged
- `sanitize-session-history.test.ts` — 76 tests pass unchanged

## User-visible / Behavior Changes

Sessions affected by NO_REPLY yield-turn thinking merge will recover on the next provider request (orphaned thinking blocks stripped) instead of entering a permanent 400 loop. Users with no NO_REPLY yield-turns experience no behavioral change.

## Best-fix Verdict

- **Best fix**: Yes. Minimal (1 new variable + 1 post-loop guard in `normalizeAssistantReplayBlockContent`), targeted (only fires when silent text was dropped and remaining content is orphaned thinking blocks), uses existing normalization infrastructure.
- **Refactor needed**: No.
- **Alternative considered**: Broader guard in `convertMessages` to detect and split multiple-thinking-block messages. Rejected because the root cause is in the normalization pipeline; fixing at the provider layer would mask the structural gap.

## AI Assistance

- **AI-assisted**: Yes
- **Co-Authored-By**: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>
- **Human confirmed understanding of code changes**: Yes

## Risks and Mitigations

- **Companion thinking block dropped when tool_use is present**: Guarded by the `every()` check — only orphaned thinking blocks (no tool_use, no text) are affected.
- **Missing a legitimate thinking-only assistant**: A thinking-only assistant without companion text would have been preserved pre-fix, and the issue reporter confirms such messages carry no replay value. The related PR #99383 takes the broader approach of dropping all completed-turn thinking blocks.
- **Compatibility**: No config, env, or migration impact.

## Security Impact

- [x] New permissions/capabilities? No
- [x] Secrets/tokens handling changed? No
- [x] New/changed network calls? No
- [x] Command/tool execution surface changed? No
- [x] Data access scope changed? No

## Human Verification

- Verified scenarios: NO_REPLY yield with thinking, full adjacency chain, tool_use boundary
- Edge cases checked: thinking block with tool_use companion, thinking block as only content
- What you did NOT verify: Live Anthropic API round-trip

## Compatibility / Migration

- [x] Backward compatible? Yes
- [x] Config/env changes? No
- [x] Migration needed? No
